definitions: To present a bill or invoice to (someone) for goods or services.
To advertise or describe (someone or something) in a particular way, especially so as to promote them.
To list (a person or event) on a programme.
To charge (a person or an account) with a sum of money.
To exchange pecks with (as doves do); to caress fondly.
examples: The company billed me for the repairs.
He was billed as the next big star.
The band is billed to play next week.
The cost was billed to my credit card.
